Author: unknown
Name: Auto Craft Cycle
Description: Repeats material restocking and crafting in inn rooms, collectable deliveries, scrip exchanges, and optional Grand Company deliveries. Supports IPC integration with other plugins.
Punchline: Automates material restocking, crafting, collectable delivery, and scrip exchange.
Changelog: Adds MinasisUI support and makes it the default UI.

Author: unknown
Name: Submarine Sell Item Tracker
Description: Tracks eight submarine salvage items, NPC sale values, and character-held gil across characters. Includes automatic scans, service account and world summaries, CSV export, and AutoRetainer completion reports through Discord webhooks. Use /ssit to open or /ssit settings to configure notifications.
Punchline: Track submarine salvage items and sale values across characters.
Changelog: Aligns daily and monthly history columns and item counts. Makes the status window resizable, collapsible and closable, and adds a reopen button. Removes import controls while preserving existing history.

Author: unknown
Name: Submarine Logistics Manager
Description: Use /slm to open. Manage submarine supplies, NPC selling, free destinations, stock warnings, and character runs in data center and world priority order. Export low-stock or all-character JSON with owned quantities and client-specific filenames, then merge two receiver clients in Delivery Settings. Deliver editable stacks of 999 via Dropbox IPC after confirming that the matched recipient has stopped for half a second. The supplier stays in place after reaching the handover coordinate until the next world or a pause/resume. Shows remaining required stacks and live inventory shortages. Includes separate supply and sale execution, safe pause/cancel/skip, persistent progress, and home-world return after completion. Requires Lifestream and vnavmesh; supplier trading also requires Dropbox. Merged delivery queues follow configured named DC and world priorities. JSON export previews and supply runs display their fixed target lists in queue order.
Punchline: Manage submarine supplies, supplier trading, NPC selling, and multi-character runs.
Changelog: Adds a Debug section at the bottom of General Settings with a Log In All Characters button. Visits every registered character in configured DC/world order, waits five seconds after confirming login, then logs out before continuing. The final character also logs out. Does not teleport, move, trade, sell, return to FC housing, or apply the configured completion action. Preserves supply/sale selections and completion flags, prevents concurrent runs, supports safe cancellation after the current logout, and records failures after three total attempts per step.

Author: unknown
Name: FC Housing Manager
Punchline: Manage housing lotteries across multiple characters and worlds.
Description: Use /fchm to open. Creates housing lottery schedules, automates character switching, plot travel, lottery entry and refunds, records entry numbers from game messages, and sends lottery numbers to Discord. Requires Lifestream; vnavmesh is used when a placard approach is needed. Service account selection follows Lifestream or AutoRetainer registration.
Changelog: Rebuilds the UI and adds world-filtered schedules, batch creation, automatic entry/refund tracking, public Lifestream IPC switching, unclaimed-refund warnings, and read-only history. Migrates legacy character identities as Anima. In-game verification is required.

Author: unknown
Name: Vanity Collection Manager
Punchline: Track unlocked vanity collectibles and discover how to obtain missing items.
Description: Use /vcm to open. Tracks mounts, minions, emotes, Triple Triad cards, chocobo bardings, orchestrion rolls, fashion accessories, and facewear. Includes acquisition sources from FFXIV Collect, tradeability filters, character-specific favorites, and CSV export. Hairstyles are planned and are not included in this initial build.
Changelog: Initial API 15 compatibility build with the existing eight collection categories. Adds /vcm, preserves the legacy command, protects existing acquisition data on update failures, and stores settings in the plugin configuration directory.

Author: unknown
Name: Memo Canvas
Punchline: Organize rich-text notes and display them in independent windows.
Description: Use /memc to manage rich-text notes in two-level folders. Includes independent and paged note windows with editing modes, resizable text input areas, disposable notes that vanish when closed, drag-and-drop ordering, chat metadata cleanup, manual and timed saving, saved window layouts, plugin-scoped fonts, and customizable MinasisUI theme presets.
Changelog: Adopts MinasisUI shared controls and styling with dedicated rich-text and diagram editors. Fixes cursor and visual-line navigation, persists typing styles, adds underline and italic, rasterizes fonts for display sizes, stabilizes responsive diagram layout and drag initiation, adds a physical-key shortcut fallback, and simplifies folder selection and diagram controls.
